name: Marsh Creek State Park
description: Marsh Creek State Park (Cowell Ranch/John Marsh) near Brentwood covers 3,659 acres of natural habitat and includes the historic John Marsh Home, completed in 1856. It is one of California's newest state parks and is not currently open to the public.
fullDescription: Marsh Creek State Park (Cowell Ranch/John Marsh) near Brentwood covers 3,659 acres of natural habitat and includes the historic John Marsh Home, completed in 1856. It is one of California's newest state parks and is not currently open to the public.
whatTheyOffer:
- Future state park with natural habitat, wildlife, and the historic John Marsh Home
- Not currently open to the public; State Parks and the City of Brentwood have planned future public access
- Occasional guided events (such as First Day Hikes) may be announced on the State Parks events calendar
howToGetIt: The park is not currently open for general public use. Check the State Parks page for any scheduled events, or call the Diablo Range District, Contra Solano Sector, at 925-673-2891.
keywords: Marsh Creek, state park, Brentwood, Contra Costa County, hiking, nature, wetlands, birding
